name: Drop-in T-nut, M5 (20 series)
summary: Drop-in slot nut for 2020 extrusion: 10.5 x 6 x 4.3 mm, M5 thread, takes a 6 mm slot anywhere along its length.
description: A drop-in M5 T-nut for a 6 mm profile slot. Includes the body and a simplified nominal 5 mm bore; the internal thread and locking ridges are not modelled.
source: Adam's Bits (endmill.com.au) drop-in T-nut listing gives the 20 series (2020) nut as 10.5 x 6 x 4.3 mm for a 6 mm slot with M3, M4 and M5 thread options, and gives the 30 series (3030) nut as 16 x 8 x 6.5 mm for an 8 mm slot; the 20-series figures are the ones used here, and the 6 mm across the nut matches the 20-series slot opening. Approximate because the size comes from a retailer's listing rather than a mechanical drawing, and because only the envelope is published: this entry draws a 10.5 x 6 x 4.3 mm body with a nominal 5 mm bore, but no helical thread, raised boss or knurl, so treat it as a space claim rather than a picture of the real nut. The M5 thread is what this variant stands for; the same body exists in M3 and M4.
